summary: Merged 2 clean dependabot PRs in Next.js-SaaS (eslint-config-next, autoprefixer). All other repos (analytics-service-toolkit, btc-llm-sentiment, kinz-accounting-analysis, feed-quality-gate, kinz-competitor-intelligence, kinz-margin-guardian-pipeline, kinz-price-bridge) had green default-branch CI and nothing new mergeable; btc-llm-sentiment's 5 dependabot PRs and kinz-secure-commerce-hub's remaining 5 PRs stay open on previously-diagnosed, not-small issues (ML-stack re-pin, Trivy OS CVE, coupled Next16/eslint10 tooling break).
